payload.title: Preserve complete task words in versioned research task-card normalization
payload.summary: Priority2 scientific-input correctness. Increment25 task_population._normalized_task_wording strips the add/support/enable prefix without a word boundary: added evidence becomes ed evidence, additional evidence becomes itional evidence, supported sources becomes ed sources. Original frozen card i25-c0fabcb195e2 retains the damaged query; later Increment27 judgment rationale explicitly records uncertainty from the truncated purpose. This does not establish counterfactual ranking outcomes or corrupt binding. Frozen code/cards/ranks/judgments must remain unchanged. Correct only future authoring through an explicitly versioned successor or guarded maintained caller after compatibility review; do not silently rerun original science.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: independently authored tests cover complete leading verbs, inflected verbs, prefix-sharing ordinary words, case, separators, empty subject/body fallback and bookkeeping removal. Preserve original task evidence and disclose any normalization in the public authored contract. A new schema/version binds corrected purpose/query and provenance; old frozen artifacts remain byte-identical and old judgments are not transferred to changed needs. Demonstrate one future real authoring consumer using the corrected contract, plus altered-need rejection in judgment reuse. Reconcile existing historical limitations through current audit navigation rather than rewriting sealed outcomes. Suitable for a narrowly scoped maintenance agent after version/caller approval.
payload.uncertainty: No current production tokenizer or live coding task changed. Semantic quality of historical commit subjects remains independently limited even after prefix repair; no general task-intent parser is authorized.
